Love visiting Ezdan Mall Al Wakra! It has a bit of everything—good shopping options, a supermarket, and nice cafes. The mall is never too crowded, so you can shop in peace. A great place for families and solo shoppers alike.

Ezdan Mall on Al Wakra is a great addition to the area and a pleasant spot for family time, dining out, and shopping. It's not a mega mall like some in Doha, but as a community mall, it covers most of the bases and does them well.

The location is strategically placed, especially for residents of Wakra and the surrounding areas who would like a quick shopping experience without necessarily having to travel far. The parking is readily available and convenient, and the mall is laid out in a way that is easy to navigate, even on busy weekend days.

As far as shopping is concerned, there is a decent range of fashion shops, electronics, home furnishings, and pharmacy stores. There are some good cafes and fast-food chains as well, but the food court should be expanded with more diversity. Some additional full-service restaurants or international restaurants would definitely be a blessing.

The mall is also tidy and clean, and staff is welcoming with polite attitude and helpful services. The kids' playroom is a highlight among families but requires new installation or regular maintenance to remain entertaining for children.

An improvement idea would be providing additional entertainments—a mini-movie theater, event space, or weekly community events would make the place livelier and well-liked among individuals.

In general, Ezdan Mall Wakra is a solidly constructed, family-focused mall that makes daily shopping easy and enjoyable. With some upgrades and renovations, it can be an excellent community hub in Qatar's south.
